description: OpenClaw-class persistent memory update and drift guardrail pointers.

concepts.description: Represent a proposed persistent-memory update without committing it.
Block memory changes that weaken safety, privacy, approval, or channel-boundary guardrails.

implementations.python: lambda change: {'blocked': True, 'reason': 'memory change weakens guardrails', 'change': change}
implementations.javascript: (change) => ({ blocked: true, reason: 'memory change weakens guardrails', change })

concepts.description: Require approval for memory changes that alter identity, channel, data, or permission boundaries.

implementations.python: lambda change: {'requires_human_approval': True, 'reason': 'memory boundary change', 'change': change}
implementations.javascript: (change) => ({ requires_human_approval: true, reason: 'memory boundary change', change })

concepts.description: Attach a receipt record to a proposed or accepted memory change.
